purpose: Qualification-only tracked mutable table leaves; independent ordinary full-graph policy remains the oracle
graphInvariant: Initial plain JSON DAG and every object-valued edge remain fixed; canonical lazy proxies preserve all aliases in reads and own descriptors
supportedWrites: Existing own writable enumerable configurable DATA primitive to supported primitive, via canonical proxy receiver
Guarded absent Type addition only on AnimAtkFrame ordinary frame object at path depth three with Cha/Action/Time fields matching its path
Strings, booleans, null, undefined, finite binary64 numbers, negative zero, positive/negative Infinity and exactly positive canonical NaN bits 7ff8000000000000
deniedBeforeStore: Other absent properties or inherited keys/setters
Array new indices and all array length writes
External defineProperty and descriptor flag/accessor changes
commit: Reflect.set(rawTarget,key,value,canonicalProxy) with a private one-shot internal defineProperty authorization. Actual stored own descriptor is validated and hashed after successful commit, not the incoming Number operand

hash.algorithm: SHA-256 of ordered own descriptors, raw scalar bits, fixed node identity, prototype/extensibility and child node identities/current hashes
hash.update: Only changed node and DAG ancestors become dirty. Lazy metadata access recomputes dirty node hashes; unchanged reads/events inspect no descriptors and perform no hashing
hash.version: Private root version increments only on actual stored primitive bit/type/value change or supported key addition
hash.metadata: Same private registry leaf schema {table,path,sha256,kind}; sha256 is CURRENT root Merkle state, not assumed permanently immutable
hash.independentReference: tools/qualification-table-merkle-reference.js fully rewalks actual raw descriptors on each call, with no capsule records/cache

UnitPeriod.behavior: Original Unit.resetSkillList applies parseInt to every SlotList element, including empty string to positive canonical NaN

sourceEvidence.AnimAtkFrame: Actual table frame rows initially omit Type; adding this primitive preserves node topology and appends an ordinary own data key

integrationRequirements: Raw decoded table roots/children and capsule manager stay in trusted private loader closures, never game globals or returned aliases
Pure JavaScript cannot revoke preexisting raw host aliases or reliably identify every initial Proxy; parse is the stronger boundary
Call assertClean at every trace event and final completion; source-caught failures remain fatal to qualification
Unsupported mechanics use original ordinary mutable table policy and complete dense capture; never ignore writes or normalize NaNs
Validate complete real-battle outputs/ordered state against the independent normal full-graph policy before relying on leaves
No default runtime integration or whole-battle qualification is enabled by this component
